execution_contract.profile_cost_and_latency: unspecified; compiler defaults zero, never measured costs
execution_contract.real_operator_bindings: explicit injection required; not provided by this generator
execution_contract.resource_resolution: Bindings resolve immutable corpus/schema/database snapshots from resource_version.

generation.deduplication: Exact directed isomorphism ignoring IDs, operator names and parameters; signature is only a bucket key.
generation.history_node_ids: construction-time IDs; final IDs are renumbered

sql.classify.description: Classify query complexity and annotate generation context.
sql.classify.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.decompose.description: Decompose the question into relational requirements.
sql.decompose.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.execute.description: Execute candidate SQL read-only with timeout; return execution diagnostics, never gold comparisons.
sql.execute.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.generate.description: Generate one candidate SQL using every parent context.
sql.generate.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.join_analysis.description: Resolve join paths, keys and cardinality constraints.
sql.join_analysis.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.merge_context.description: Merge all parent schema annotations, preserving disagreements.
sql.merge_context.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.prune_schema.description: Annotate selected schema elements for a relational concern; retain immutable base schema and join keys rather than destructively removing them.
sql.prune_schema.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.repair.description: Revise SQL from current question, schema and observed execution diagnostics.
sql.repair.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.retrieve_values.description: Read database values for grounding without modifying the database.
sql.retrieve_values.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.schema_linking.description: Link the current question to a fixed database schema and evidence.
sql.schema_linking.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.select_and_correct.description: Compare all candidates, then review the selected SQL; fused terminal selection.
sql.select_and_correct.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

provenance.note: Shorter variants omit stages; fork/join and bounded refinements extend the cited stage organization.
